name: prebuilt/engineering-team-size
description: Estimate engineering-team size via a free identity resolution and title roster, then a cost-ordered ladder: a limit=1 CrustData title count, CrustData company enrichment, and a final PDL company-enrich fallback.

stages.sourceText:
ctx.tools.execute({
      id: 'company_clean_identity_resolution',
      tool: 'peopledatalabs_company_clean',
      input: { website: domain },
      description:
        'Resolve the canonical company identity (LinkedIn URL) before any billable lookup. The Cleaner API is free.',
    })
stages.description: Resolve the canonical company identity (LinkedIn URL) before any billable lookup. The Cleaner API is free.

steps.sourceText:
ctx.tools.execute({
    id: 'pdl_engineering_company_enrich',
    tool: 'peopledatalabs_enrich_company',
    input: { domain },
    description:
      'PDL fallback via Company Enrich: one 1-credit call returning the full company record, from which the R&D headcount class and its 12-month growth rate are read.',
  })
